process_note: The commit that first announced this rescan described this artifact before it existed: the writing step failed on a working-directory slip and only the commit ran. Recorded here rather than fixed by rewriting history, because a commit message that promised a file is exactly the kind of small untruth this repository exists to not accumulate.

resurrected_candidate.THE_UNTESTED_RISK: A2, and it is why this is a LEAD not a finding. Round 2 recorded it as ENTIRELY UNMEASURED. The broadcast URA/SISA index is the operator's own error bound and ships FREE INSIDE THE STUDENT'S INPUT, so a per-satellite mean scaled by age-of-data is an obvious and possibly dominant dumb baseline. Five candidates died at exactly this gate and none expected to.
resurrected_candidate.asymmetry: The cleanest in the entire search and the closest structural analogue to VPT in it: the manufacturer LITERALLY OBSERVES THE FUTURE the student must predict, reconstructed days later from a ~500-station global tracking network the student has no access to.
resurrected_candidate.buyer: GNSS correction and integrity providers - Swift Navigation, Point One, Trimble RTX, u-blox PointPerfect - selling tighter protection levels to autonomous vehicles and precision agriculture.
resurrected_candidate.label_factory: Propagate each broadcast record; difference against the precise SP3/CLK product at matching epochs. One-time download, then zero marginal cost.
resurrected_candidate.name: EphemErr - GNSS broadcast-ephemeris error nowcasting
resurrected_candidate.task: From the broadcast navigation message alone - what every GNSS receiver on Earth already holds - predict how wrong that message will turn out to be.

the_reframe.new_criterion: find a STUDIED problem with a published small-scale result and NO open dataset at 10^6, where the gap is EFFORT not insight. Under this lens 'crowded' stops disqualifying - a published small-scale result is EVIDENCE THE MECHANISM WORKS. What disqualifies is an open dataset at scale, because the effort is already spent.
the_reframe.old_criterion: find an UNSTUDIED problem. Lost five rounds - 99 candidates, 8 adversarial reviews, 4 market-timed candidates, 0 selected.
the_reframe.why: FDM-1 is usually misread as an information edge. VPT was published in 2022, screen recordings were not a secret, inverse dynamics models were textbook. What nobody wanted to do was build an 11-million-hour pseudo-labelling pipeline.
